top_concerns: Cross-layer proxy validated only by weak-to-moderate Spearman correlation (0.2-0.4); 'sufficient statistic' overclaimed, no top-h overlap or output-error metric
ST-SpAttn 'purification' motivation never measured; ablations on a single MVBench task with no variance, and no ST-SpAttn-only or CLIE-benefit control
Suspicious/unfair baselines: LOOK-M near zero, baselines collapse on VideoLLaMA2, PureKV beats full cache on Qwen at 20%; baselines lack the sparse prefill; ROUGE metric and 10-of-20 task subset
Narrow evaluation: short-video MVBench only, no long-video benchmarks, two models; AVSD gain is marginal despite 'significant' claim
Efficiency claims unsupported: no baseline latency/memory comparisons, 3.16x prefill and 5x compression are different configs, kernels and setup unspecified
